description.en_US: The source consumes the messages of a RabbitMQ queue.
description.zh_CN: 该源从 RabbitMQ 队列中消费消息。

hint.en_US: The name of the queue to consume, e.g. queue1
hint.zh_CN: 要消费的队列名称，例如 queue1

hint.en_US: The AMQP URI of the RabbitMQ server, such as amqp://127.0.0.1:5672/ or amqps://127.0.0.1:5671/vhost. Use amqps:// to connect with TLS.
hint.zh_CN: RabbitMQ 服务器的 AMQP URI，例如 amqp://127.0.0.1:5672/ 或 amqps://127.0.0.1:5671/vhost。使用 amqps:// 以通过 TLS 连接。

hint.en_US: The username to connect to the server. It overrides the user in the server URI.
hint.zh_CN: 连接服务器的用户名，会覆盖服务器 URI 中的用户。

hint.en_US: The password to connect to the server.
The maximum number of unacknowledged messages the server delivers to eKuiper. 0 means no limit.
hint.zh_CN: 服务器向 eKuiper 推送的未确认消息的最大数量。0 表示不限制。

hint.en_US: Whether the server considers the messages acknowledged once delivered. If false, eKuiper acknowledges each message after receiving it.
hint.zh_CN: 服务器是否在投递后即认为消息已确认。若为 false，eKuiper 在接收每条消息后确认该消息。

hint.en_US: The consumer tag. If empty, the server generates one.
hint.zh_CN: 消费者标签。若为空，由服务器生成。

hint.en_US: The certification path. It can be an absolute path, or a relative path. If it is an relative path, then the base path is where you excuting the kuiperd command. For example, if you run bin/kuiperd from /var/kuiper, then the base path is /var/kuiper; If you run ./kuiperd from /var/kuiper/bin, then the base path is /var/kuiper/bin.
hint.zh_CN: 证书路径。可以为绝对路径，也可以为相对路径。如果指定的是相对路径，那么父目录为执行 kuiperd 命令的路径。比如，如果你在 /var/kuiper 中运行 bin/kuiperd ，那么父目录为 /var/kuiper; 如果运行从 /var/kuiper/bin 中运行./kuiperd，那么父目录为 /var/kuiper/bin

hint.en_US: The private key path. It can be either absolute path, or relative path, which is similar to use of certificationPath.
hint.zh_CN: 私钥路径。可以为绝对路径，也可以为相对路径，相对路径的用法与 certificationPath 类似

hint.en_US: The location of root ca path. It can be an absolute path, or a relative path.
hint.zh_CN: 根证书路径，用以验证服务器证书。可以为绝对路径，也可以为相对路径。

hint.en_US: If InsecureSkipVerify is true, TLS accepts any certificate presented by the server and any host name in that certificate.  In this mode, TLS is susceptible to man-in-the-middle attacks. The default value is false. The configuration item can only be used with TLS connections.
hint.zh_CN: 如果 InsecureSkipVerify 设置为 true, TLS 接受服务器提供的任何证书以及该证书中的任何主机名。 在这种模式下，TLS 容易受到中间人攻击。默认值为 false。配置项只能用于 TLS 连接。
